task.title: Inventory existing Muse and Instinct AI coordination bindings
task.scope: Inspect accessible local source and Josh's authorized Gmail connector without creating agents, reusing OAuth access, or sending a message.

approval: Josh explicitly authorized this coordination inventory and limited it to existing agents and authorized connectors.
intent: Find attributable existing agents and private routes without mistaking an OAuth notice or mailbox delivery for an agent binding or execution authority.

evidence: Scoped workspace and directory searches found no attributable Muse or Instinct AI implementation, connector, or direct private route.
The authorized Gmail connector search found historical notices naming an OAuth application called Instinct.
The findings were recorded with source/search limits in reports/2026-10-20-muse-instinct-inventory.md.
Rosco receipt and local Markdown-link validation were run after the record update.
No message, OAuth action, Slack action, new agent, schedule, polling loop, paid fallback, deployment, or production change was initiated.

authority.basis: The user directed read-only inventory through existing authorized connectors and prohibited replacement agents or credential sharing.

facts.label: CONFIRMED
facts.claim: No attributable Muse or Instinct AI agent instance or direct coordination channel was found in the accessible workspace and authorized Gmail searches.
facts.source: Scoped local search, directory scan, and Gmail search results

facts.label: INFERRED
facts.claim: An application named Instinct was historically authorized against account data associated with the mailbox.
facts.source: Historical GitHub and Google security notices

facts.label: UNKNOWN
facts.claim: Muse and Instinct AI identities, operators, current permissions, direct channels, receipt, and work outcomes.
facts.source: No attributable agent endpoint or direct acknowledgement found

handoff.next_action: Bind a named existing agent and mutually authorized private route, then perform one read-only correlation-tagged receipt-reference exchange.
blockers: No attributable existing Muse or Instinct AI instance or direct private channel is available in this environment.
An OAuth application notice is not sufficient authority or identity evidence.
